integrity: The universal claim is supported by exact algebraic identities and a mean-value argument. The bundled finite rational checks are corroborative only. Self-review passed; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the invariant set I={(u,v):v=1}.
It does not exclude two-periodic Gibbs measures outside I and does not classify higher periods, extremality, reconstruction, or thermodynamic dominance.
title: A strict logarithmic contraction closes the two-periodic SOS conjecture
